```{=html}
<div class="maps-hero">
  <p class="maps-eyebrow">// work</p>
  <h1 class="maps-title">Maps & Visuals</h1>
  <p class="maps-sub">Some maps, charts and animations made with Python</p>
</div>

<!-- ── METEOROLOGY ── -->
<div class="carousel-section">
  <div class="carousel-header">
    <span class="carousel-label">Meteorology</span>
  </div>
  <div class="carousel-track-wrap">
    <div class="carousel-track" id="track-met">
      <a href="maps/plot1.html" target="_blank" class="carousel-item">
        <div class="carousel-img-wrap">
          <img src="images/visuals/plot1.jpg" alt="Weather stations Spain"/>
        </div>
        <p class="carousel-caption">Weather station coverage across Spain</p>
        <span class="carousel-type">Static map</span>
      </a>
    </div>
    <button class="carousel-btn carousel-prev" onclick="scroll_carousel('track-met', -1)">&#8592;</button>
    <button class="carousel-btn carousel-next" onclick="scroll_carousel('track-met', 1)">&#8594;</button>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ── WATER ── -->
<div class="carousel-section">
  <div class="carousel-header">
    <span class="carousel-label">Water</span>
  </div>
  <div class="carousel-track-wrap">
    <div class="carousel-track" id="track-water">
      <a href="maps/plot2.html" target="_blank" class="carousel-item">
        <div class="carousel-img-wrap">
          <img src="images/visuals/plot2.png" alt="Spanish river basins"/>
        </div>
        <p class="carousel-caption">Spanish river basin districts with HydroRIVERS</p>
        <span class="carousel-type">Static map</span>
      </a>
      <a href="maps/rivers-europe.html" target="_blank" class="carousel-item">
        <div class="carousel-img-wrap">
          <img src="images/visuals/rivers_europe_minimal.png" alt="European Rivers"/>
        </div>
        <p class="carousel-caption">European rivers</p>
        <span class="carousel-type">Static map</span>
      </a>
    </div>
    <button class="carousel-btn carousel-prev" onclick="scroll_carousel('track-water', -1)">&#8592;</button>
    <button class="carousel-btn carousel-next" onclick="scroll_carousel('track-water', 1)">&#8594;</button>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ── CLIMATE CHANGE ── -->
<div class="carousel-section">
  <div class="carousel-header">
    <span class="carousel-label">Climate Change</span>
  </div>
  <div class="carousel-track-wrap">
    <div class="carousel-track" id="track-cc">
      <a href="maps/co2-seaice.html" target="_blank" class="carousel-item">
        <div class="carousel-img-wrap">
          <video autoplay loop muted playsinline>
            <source src="images/visuals/co2-seaice.mp4" type="video/mp4"/>
          </video>
        </div>
        <p class="carousel-caption">CO₂ and sea ice extent</p>
        <span class="carousel-type">Animated time series</span>
      </a>
    </div>
    <button class="carousel-btn carousel-prev" onclick="scroll_carousel('track-cc', -1)">&#8592;</button>
    <button class="carousel-btn carousel-next" onclick="scroll_carousel('track-cc', 1)">&#8594;</button>
  </div>
</div>

<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:wght@400;700&family=DM+Sans:wght@300;400;500&display=swap');

body { background: #eefbfe; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
#quarto-header, .navbar { display: none !important; }
#quarto-content, main.content, #quarto-document-content {
  margin: 0 !important; padding: 0 !important; max-width: 100% !important;
}

/* ── Hero ── */
.maps-hero {
  padding: 7rem 3rem 3rem 3rem;
  max-width: 1200px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}
.maps-eyebrow {
  font-family: monospace;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  color: #92a7f2;
  letter-spacing: 0.15em;
  margin: 0 0 0.5rem 0;
}
.maps-title {
  font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
  font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 4rem);
  color: #30384b;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin: 0 0 0.8rem 0;
  line-height: 1;
}
.maps-sub {
  font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
  font-size: 0.92rem;
  color: #888;
  margin: 0;
}

/* ── Carousel section ── */
.carousel-section {
  margin-bottom: 4rem;
  padding: 0 3rem;
  max-width: 1200px;
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-right: auto;
  margin-bottom: 5rem;
}

.carousel-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 1rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(146,167,242,0.2);
  padding-bottom: 0.6rem;
}

.carousel-label {
  font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #30384b;
  letter-spacing: 0.01em;
}

/* ── Track ── */
.carousel-track-wrap {
  position: relative;
}

.carousel-track {
  display: flex;
  gap: 1.5rem;
  overflow-x: auto;
  scroll-behavior: smooth;
  scrollbar-width: none;
  -ms-overflow-style: none;
  padding-bottom: 1rem;
}
.carousel-track::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

/* ── Item ── */
.carousel-item {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  width: clamp(280px, 32vw, 420px);
  text-decoration: none;
  color: inherit;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.6rem;
}

.carousel-img-wrap {
  width: 100%;
  aspect-ratio: 4/3;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: #dce8fd;
}

.carousel-img-wrap img,
.carousel-img-wrap video {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  display: block;
  transition: transform 0.5s ease;
}

.carousel-item:hover .carousel-img-wrap img,
.carousel-item:hover .carousel-img-wrap video {
  transform: scale(1.04);
}

.carousel-caption {
  font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  color: #30384b;
  margin: 0;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.carousel-type {
  font-family: monospace;
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  color: #92a7f2;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

/* ── Nav buttons ── */
.carousel-btn {
  position: absolute;
  top: 35%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  background: white;
  border: 1px solid rgba(146,167,242,0.3);
  color: #30384b;
  width: 40px;
  height: 40px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  font-size: 1rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  transition: background 0.2s, border-color 0.2s;
  z-index: 10;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
}
.carousel-btn:hover { background: #92a7f2; color: white; border-color: #92a7f2; }
.carousel-prev { left: -20px; }
.carousel-next { right: -20px; }

@media (max-width: 700px) {
  .maps-hero, .carousel-section { padding-left: 1.5rem; padding-right: 1.5rem; }
  .carousel-prev { left: -10px; }
  .carousel-next { right: -10px; }
  .carousel-item { width: 75vw; }
}
</style>

<script>
function scroll_carousel(id, dir) {
  const track = document.getElementById(id);
  const itemW = track.querySelector('.carousel-item').offsetWidth + 24;
  track.scrollBy({ left: dir * itemW, behavior: 'smooth' });
}
</script>
```
